versioning.patch: post-1.0: bug fixes and documentation only; pre-1.0 (current 0.x): fixes, documentation, and any API change, provided the release ships an upgrade note with a migration example
versioning.major: breaking API, package, or wire-contract changes
versioning.pre1Policy: 0.x minor releases may still contain breaking changes; 0.x patch releases may change the API too, provided the same release ships an upgrade note with a migration example; 1.0.0 restores the strict post-1.0 rules

deprecation.exception: security or legal removal may shorten notice with an ADR

requiredChecks: moon tree has no monorepo source
